title: Project test interpreter
summary: Tests run on the project's own Python, never Yoke's. yoke watch pytest uses the locked source environment in a Yoke checkout, uv run for a uv project (pyproject.toml beside uv.lock) or a declared test_environment, and otherwise the repo root's .venv. With no .venv it refuses with PROJECT-ENVIRONMENT-MISSING and names the setup_command capability that creates it. A Command case in another project's checkout puts that checkout's .venv first on PATH and sets VIRTUAL_ENV, so python -m pytest runs the project's tests; YOKE_PYTHON always names Yoke's interpreter.
